core.title: DEVELOPMENT AND PROPERTIES OF LOW-CALCIUM FLY ASH-BASED GEOPOLYMER CONCRETE
core.abstract: This Research Report describes the first part of the work carried out by the geopolymer research group at Curtin University of Technology. It describes the development and properties of heat-cured low-calcium fly ash-based geopolymer concrete. This Report will be followed by two other Reports describing the long-term properties of geopolymer concrete, and the behaviour of reinforced geopolymer concrete beams and columns.

research_domain.problem_statement: F/GGBS mix ratios 75:25 / 50:50 / 25:75 compressive strength benchmarks
